definitions.explanation: A feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {喜|よろこ}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.notes: {喜|よろこ}びの{涙|なみだ} = tears of joy

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喜|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かち{合|あ}った→分かち合う：18203_wakachiau⟧。
examples.english: We shared the joy of passing the exam.
examples.notes: {喜|よろこ}びを{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う = to share joy

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{喜|よろこ}び⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Watching my child grow is a great joy.

notes:
USAGE: {喜|よろこ}び is the noun form of the verb ⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧ (to be happy). It expresses positive emotions like joy and delight.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {喜|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel joy)
- {喜|よろこ}び⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う→分かち合う：18203_wakachiau⟧ (to share joy)
- {喜|よろこ}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (cries of joy)
- {喜|よろこ}び⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears of joy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧ - enjoyment, pleasure
- ⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧ - happiness
- ⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧ - great joy (formal)
